evals.prompt: good morning, give me my briefing for today
evals.expected_output: A structured daily intelligence briefing with 🔴 Must Do, 🟡 Should Do, 🔵 This Week sections. ChromaDB is queried first and briefing rendered before delta ingestion runs. Delta sync result appears as a footer line after the briefing body.
assertions: The output contains a '# Daily Intelligence Briefing' header with today's date
The output contains the '🔴 TODAY — Must Do' section header
The output contains the '🟡 TODAY — Should Do' section header
The output contains the '🔵 THIS WEEK — Plan Ahead' section header
The output contains the '🔔 REMINDERS & FOLLOW-UPS' section header
The delta ingestion status line appears at the end (either ↻, ✓, or ⚠️ sync line)
Items in the briefing include source citations in [WA:, Jira:, Alert:] format
The skill does NOT wait for ingestion before rendering the briefing (ChromaDB query runs first)

evals.prompt: what should I work on today? there was an incident last night with service desk
evals.expected_output: A briefing that surfaces the service desk incident as a high-priority item. Incident referenced from WhatsApp war room messages in ChromaDB. Delta sync runs after and appends a status line.
assertions: The output contains a '# Daily Intelligence Briefing' header
The incident or 'service desk' is mentioned in the 🔴 or 🟡 section
The item cites its WhatsApp source with [WA: ...] citation format
A delta sync footer line appears at the bottom of the output
The briefing renders from ChromaDB data without first waiting for a WAHA network fetch

evals.prompt: morning briefing please, also check if SIPGN-1700 needs action
evals.expected_output: A full morning briefing plus a mention of SIPGN-1700 with its status. SIPGN-1700 should appear in the high-priority sections since it was escalated in WhatsApp and is stale (>7 days). Delta sync footer at end.
assertions: The output contains a '# Daily Intelligence Briefing' header
SIPGN-1700 is mentioned in the briefing
SIPGN-1700 appears in 🔴 or 🟡 section (it is stale and escalated)
The output contains a staleness warning (⚠️ STALE) for items not updated recently
A delta sync footer line appears at the bottom
